text:
morgan: quick thread  we need a unified retirement runbook for models that degrade after infra/quant changes. primary goals: clear tenant-facing steps, finance reconciliation for credits, and a short ops checklist for emergency fixes.
ravi: actionable ask: create a per-tenant Retirement Plan object with fields: risk_score_label, recommended_action, credit_estimate, canary_plan, and audit_reference. expose via API /tenants/:id/retirement_plan.
sasha: benchmarks to gate decisions: p95 latency delta, embed cosine mean shift, hallucination regression rate on curated prompts, and token-cost pct change. prefer small, deterministic golden sets per tenant.
tom: CS perspective: tenants want control. recommend 3 preference modes exposed in console: auto (system migrates), assist (CS schedules), hold (stay pinned). default = assist for enterprise, auto for trial/smaller tenants.
uma: ops checklist (short): 1) run fast-sim (24h sample) 2) if red -> pin immediately + notify 3) run full-sim + create retirement_plan 4) schedule canary per plan 5) watch 7d and confirm/rollback. include quick rollback commands in doc.morgan: finance: credits model needs a reconciliation_id in the plan. propose formula: credit = min(tenant_spend*0.03, $750) for auto-tier, escalate for assist/manual. ledger entries must reference migration_incident_{ts}.
ravi: runtime detail: add metadata flags to model catalog: retirement_state (none|notified|pinned|aliasing|retired), alias_target, retirement_id. also tenant metadata: migration_preference, migration_credit_eligibility.
sasha: evaluation cadence for canary: small tenants 48h at 5% traffic; medium 7d at 2%; large => replay-only until approval. collect paired diffs and store into a cohort bucket tagged by retirement_id.
tom: comms templates: short advisory (what we saw), preview link to retirement_plan, options CTA (Run preview / Schedule help / Stay pinned). include one-line exec summary for account owner: "Impact low/med/high".
uma: infra notes: simulator must be sandboxed and should not touch production KV caches; use a read-only replay path. store snapshots with PII scrubbed, TTL 60d. provide tenant opt-out toggle.morgan: audit/legal: every auto-migrate or credit grant must create an audit record with user, timestamp, retirement_id, and rule_version. audit-bot should surface these in /audit stream.
ravi: can we add a lightweight Migration Simulator CLI for CSMs: `ri migrate-sim --tenant T --model M --sample 0.5%` returns a short JSON summary and a report_url. include a small one-liner they can paste into ticket.
sasha: scoring: compute a composite risk [0..1] weighted: quality(0.6), embed_shift(0.2), perf(0.1), cost(0.1). risk bands => green <0.15, amber 0.15-0.4, red >0.4. map to actions auto/assist/block.
tom: post-migration watch: 14-day window with alerts for p95 +20%, embed_sim drop below amber, error_rate +1%. automatic rollback if red triggers within the first 24h for auto-tier.
uma: implementor tasks: schema bump for tenant_meta, add retirement_plan endpoint, simulator sandbox, UI CTA + ticket template. prefer feature flags for staged rollout.morgan: finance operations: create migration_credit_bucket and a daily job that marks credits as pending and then reconciles once migration completes or after 30d. credits must be traceable to retirement_id.
ravi: owners: sasha (benchmarks & sim), numa (infra & canary), tom (CS & comms), morgan (policy & finance). meet Thursday 10am to review API spec + sample retirement_plan payload.
audit-bot: note: branch retirement-runbook queued; schema change tenant_meta.v6 pending review.
morgan: final note: keep the runbook terse and actionable. CSMs need copy-paste commands and clear thresholds. follow-up: API spec draft by Wed EOD. :calendar:
